items.title: Generative AI Availability, Grades, and Student Satisfaction at a Large University
items.desc: Tests the "GenAI substitution hypothesis" that students offload cognitive effort to generative AI to earn higher grades without learning, using grade and satisfaction data from a large university. [arXiv econ.GN, posted 2026-07-23]

items.title: The Evolution of Digital Search: From Blue Links to Delegated Decision-Making
items.desc: Argues digital search is shifting from a human-driven process of discovery toward an agent-mediated system of delegated decision-making, and considers the economic implications. [arXiv econ.GN, posted 2026-07-23]

items.title: pAI-Econ-claude: A Gated Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Architecture for AI-Assisted Economic Theory Development
items.desc: Proposes an LLM-based, human-in-the-loop multi-agent architecture for economic-theory tasks where no cheap, machine-readable correctness signal exists. [arXiv econ.GN / cs.MA, posted 2026-07-23]

items.title: Execution and Evaluation: A New Occupational Measure and Long-Run Employment Gradients
items.desc: Argues AI automates execution (producing output) more readily than evaluation (judging whether it is correct), and builds an occupational measure to study long-run employment gradients. [arXiv econ.GN, posted 2026-07-23]

items.title: The Human-AI Substitution Principle: When will you be replaced by AI in your organization?
items.desc: Presents an analytical model for when a human employee will be substituted by AI within an organization, and the economic conditions that drive it. [arXiv econ.GN / cs.AI, posted 2026-07-22]

items.title: Portfolio Optimization under Dynamic Rebalancing via Topological Data Analysis and News Sentiments
items.desc: Proposes a sentiment-adjusted portfolio optimization framework that integrates topological data analysis with technical indicators and FinBERT-based sentiment scores from financial news. [arXiv q-fin.PM, posted 2026-07-23]

items.title: Quantum Kernels and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns: Anatomy of a Vanishing Advantage
items.desc: Runs a controlled horse race testing whether quantum machine-learning kernels beat a classical RBF kernel for cross-sectional stock-return prediction on the Chinese A-share market. [arXiv q-fin.PR / stat.ML, posted 2026-07-22]

sections.name: 📦 Operations & Supply Chain (INFORMS: Management Science, M&SOM, Operations Research)

items.title: Group boarding for airplanes: benchmarking static policies and optimizing dynamic assignment with deep reinforcement learning
items.desc: Uses deep reinforcement learning to optimize dynamic airplane boarding-group assignment, benchmarked against static seat-based rules to reduce turnaround time and improve passenger experience. [arXiv econ.GN, posted 2026-07-23]

items.title: Can China dominate AI exports, too?
items.desc: Examines whether China can extend its manufacturing-export dominance into AI and what that would mean for the global economy. [Economist, 2026-07-23]

items.title: Could A.I. Do Your Job? We Put Agents to the Test.
items.desc: An interactive test of how well current AI agents handle real office-job tasks, probing the labor-market stakes of automation. [NYT, 2026-07-23]

items.title: As China advances in AI, Trump faces a new test in the technology race
items.desc: A wave of new Chinese AI model releases is testing Washington's regulatory and trade approach in the US-China technology race. [Washington Post, 2026-07-22]
